question: Which of the following is the sequence of measures CORRECT to a postpartum hemorrhage?

options.opa: Uterine massage, bladder catheter placement, volume replacement, administration of uterotonics and revision of the birth canal.
options.opb: Uterine massage, bladder catheter placement, volemia replacement, administration of uterotonics and transvaginal ultrasound.
options.opc: Uterine massage, bladder catheter placement, volume replacement, administration of uterotonics and uterine tamponade.
options.opd: Uterine massage, bladder catheter placement, volume replacement, administration of uterotonics and ligation of uterine arteries.
